headline: Trump Administration Admits Canceling Grants to States That Did Not Vote for Him
context: Federal officials said in court documents that they halted billions of dollars in funding for energy projects to states “based solely” on whether they backed President Trump in the 2024 election.

sources.name: The New York Times
